deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: To embed a returns reason capture form on Wix, follow these steps:
1. Log in to your Wix account and navigate to the site editor.
2. Click on the "Add a new page" button and select the "Form" template.
3. Drag and drop the "Form" element onto the page.
4. Click on the "Form" element and select the "Settings" icon.
5. In the "Settings" panel, click on the "Add a new field" button.
6. Select "Text field" and name it "Returns Reason".
7. Click on the "Add a new field" button again and select "Dropdown list".
8. Name the dropdown list "Reason for Return" and add the following options: "Defective product", "Not as described", "Not needed", "Other".
9. Click on the "Save" button to save the form settings.
10. To connect the form to your returns flow, you'll need to add a Wix Code snippet to your site. Click on the "Settings" icon in the top-right corner of the site editor and select "Wix Code".
11. In the "Wix Code" panel, click on the "Add a new code snippet" button and select "Form".

12. In the "Form" code snippet, add the following code to capture the returns reason and reason for return: `wixForm.onReady(() => { wixForm.addSubmitHandler((event) => { const returnsReason = event.detail.formValues['Returns Reason']; const reasonForReturn = event.detail.formValues['Reason for Return']; // Send the returns reason and reason for return to your returns flow API here }); });`
13. Click on the "Save" button to save the code snippet.

14. Finally, add a submit button to the form by clicking on the "Add a new element" button and selecting "Button". Name the button "Submit" and add the following code to the button: `wixForm.submit();`
15. Click on the "Save" button to save the changes.
